name: @wess2001/reaper
description: Deterministic data access security analysis for TypeScript and PostgreSQL

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run platform:typecheck && npm test && npm run platform:test
scripts.platform:serve: npm run build && npm run platform:build && node platform/dist/api.js
scripts.platform:worker: npm run build && npm run platform:build && node platform/dist/worker.js
scripts.platform:cloud:dispatch: npm run build && npm run platform:build && node platform/dist/cloud-dispatcher.js
scripts.platform:cloud:run: npm run build && npm run platform:build && node platform/dist/cloud-run-entry.js
scripts.platform:free:run: npm run build && npm run platform:build && node platform/dist/free-runner.js
